args.body: Conclude GODOT-PAID-DEBUGGING-REQUEST-FIT from existing bounded-result.json and source-inspection.json. TASK-179492256100 was read completely: official forum rules prohibit AI content, AI-service advertising and asking money for help. Obtain actual ownership and a valid lease, read saved evidence, then close this bounded qualification with a lesson if requirements are satisfied. Do not inspect more requests, implement, contact elsewhere to bypass rules or repeat discovery. Reconcile EXPLICIT-PAID-SPREADSHEET-SUPPORT-FIT from its existing bounded rejection under actual valid ownership too. These are channel-specific results, not absent market demand. Preserve every observation and retirement obligation.

description: Godot's forum rules explicitly prohibit AI content and paid-help solicitation, so that channel stops before implementation; this does not reject other markets. The completed catalogue comparison supports retaining the free diagnostic, not further paid packaging. Five unclassified feedback sources leave requests unknown; verified funds and revenue remain zero. Independent live experiments continue, with existing expiry duties preserved.
